1.1: A word of Jehovah that has been to Micah the Morashite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, that he has seen concerning Samaria and Jerusalem:
1.2: Hear, O peoples, all of them! Attend, O earth, and its fulness, And the Lord Jehovah is against you for a witness, The Lord from His holy temple.
1.3: For indeed, Jehovah is going out from His place, And He has come down, And has trodden on high places of earth.
1.4: Melted have been the mountains under Him, And the valleys do rend themselves, As wax from the presence of fire, As waters cast down by a slope.
1.5: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, And for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what the high places of Judah? Is it not Jerusalem?
1.6: And I have set Samaria for a heap of the field, For plantations of a vineyard, And poured out into a valley her stones, And her foundations I uncover.
1.7: And all her graven images are beaten down, And all her gifts are burnt with fire, And all her idols I make a desolation, For, from the hire of a harlot she gathered, and to the hire of a harlot they return.
1.8: For this I lament and howl, I go spoiled and naked, I make a lamentation like dragons, And a mourning like daughters of an ostrich.
1.9: For mortal are her wounds, For it has come to Judah, It has come to a gate of My people--to Jerusalem.
1.10: In Gath tell you not--in Acco weep not, In Beth-Aphrah, in dust roll yourself.
1.11: Pass over for you, O inhabitant of Shaphir, Naked one of shame. Not gone out has the inhabitant of Zaanan, The lamentation of Beth-Ezel does take from you its standing.
1.12: For stayed for good has the inhabitant of Maroth, For evil has come down from Jehovah to the gate of Jerusalem.
1.13: Bind the chariot to a swift beast, O inhabitant of Lachish, The beginning of sin is she to the daughter of Zion, For in you have been found the transgressions of Israel.
1.14: Therefore you give presents to Moresheth-Gath, The houses of Achzib become a lying thing to the kings of Israel.
1.15: Yet the possessor I do bring in to you, O inhabitant of Mareshah, To Adullam come in does the honour of Israel.
1.16: Make bald and shave, for your delightful sons, Enlarge your baldness as an eagle, For they have removed from you!

2.1: Woe to those devising iniquity, And working evil on their beds, In the light of the morning they do it, For their hand is--to God.
2.2: And they have desired fields, And they have taken violently, And houses, and they have taken away, And have oppressed a man and his house, Even a man and his inheritance.
2.3: Therefore, thus said Jehovah: Indeed, I am devising against this family evil, From which you do not remove your necks, Nor walk loftily, for a time of evil it is.
2.4: In that day does one take up for you a simile, And he has wailed a wailing of woe, He has said, We have been utterly spoiled, The portion of my people He does change, How does He move toward me! To the backslider our fields He apportions.
2.5: Therefore, you have no caster of a line by lot In the assembly of Jehovah.
2.6: You do not prophesy--they do prophesy, They do not prophesy to these, It does not remove shame.
2.7: Does the house of Jacob say, `Has the Spirit of Jehovah been shortened? Are these His doings?' Do not My words benefit the people that is walking uprightly?
2.8: And yesterday My people for an enemy does raise himself up, From the outer garment the honourable ornament you strip off, From the confident passers by, You who are turning back from war.
2.9: The women of My people you cast out from its delightful house, From its sucklings you take away My honour to the age.
2.10: Rise and go, for this is not the rest, Because of uncleanness it does corrupt, And corruption is powerful.
2.11: If one is going with the wind, And with falsehood has lied: `I prophesy to you of wine, and of strong drink,' He has been the prophet of this people!
2.12: I do surely gather you, O Jacob, all of you, I surely bring together the remnant of Israel, Together I do set it as the flock of Bozrah, As a drove in the midst of its pasture, It makes a noise because of man.
2.13: Gone up has the breaker before them, They have broken through, Yes, they pass through the gate, Yes, they go out through it, And pass on does their king before them, And Jehovah at their head!

3.1: And I say, `Hear, I pray you, heads of Jacob, And you judges of the house of Israel, Is it not for you to know the judgment?
3.2: You who are hating good, and loving evil, Taking violently their skin from off them, And their flesh from off their bones,
3.3: And who have eaten the flesh of My people, And their skin from off them have stript, And their bones they have broken, And they have spread them out as in a pot, And as flesh in the midst of a caldron.
3.4: Then do they cry to Jehovah, And He does not answer them, And hides His face from them at that time, As they have made evil their doings.
3.5: Thus said Jehovah concerning the prophets Who are causing My people to err, Who are biting with their teeth, And have cried `Peace,' And he who does not give to their mouth, They have sanctified against him war.
3.6: Therefore a night you have without vision, And darkness you have without divination, And gone in has the sun on the prophets, And black over them has been the day.
3.7: And ashamed have been the seers, And confounded have been the diviners, And covered their lip have all of them, For their is no answer, O God.
3.8: And yet I have been full of power by the Spirit of Jehovah, And of judgment, and of might, To declare to Jacob his transgression, And to Israel his sin.
3.9: Hear this, I pray you, heads of the house of Jacob, And you judges of the house of Israel, Who are making judgment abominable, And all uprightness do pervert.
3.10: Building up Zion with blood, And Jerusalem with iniquity.
3.11: Her heads for a bribe do judge, And her priests for hire do teach, And her prophets for silver divine, And on Jehovah they lean, saying, `Is not Jehovah in our midst? Evil does not come in upon us.'
3.12: Therefore, for your sake, Zion is ploughed a field, and Jerusalem is heaps, And the mount of the house is for high places of a forest!

4.1: And it has come to pass, In the latter end of the days, The mount of the house of Jehovah Is established above the top of the mounts, And it has been lifted up above the hills, And flowed to it have peoples.
4.2: And gone have many nations and said, Come and we go up to the mount of Jehovah, And to the house of the God of Jacob, And He does teach us of His ways, And we do walk in His paths, For from Zion does go forth a law, And a word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.
4.3: And He has judged between many peoples, And given a decision to mighty nations afar off, They have beaten their swords to ploughshares, And their spears to pruning-hooks, Nation lifts not up sword to nation, Nor do they learn war any more.
4.4: And they have sat each under his vine, And under his fig-tree, And there is none troubling, For the mouth of Jehovah of Hosts has spoken.
4.5: For all the peoples do walk, Each in the name of its god--and we, We do walk in the name of Jehovah our God, To the age and for ever.
4.6: In that day--an affirmation of Jehovah, I do gather the halting one, And the driven away one I bring together, And she whom I have afflicted.
4.7: And I have set the halting for a remnant, And the far-off for a mighty nation, And reigned has Jehovah over them in mount Zion, From now, and to the age.
4.8: And you, O tower of Eder, Fort of the daughter of Zion, to you it comes, Yes, come in has the former rule, The kingdom to the daughter of Jerusalem.
4.9: Now, why do you shout aloud? A king--is there none in you? Has your counsellor perished, That taken hold of you has pain as a travailing woman?
4.10: Be pained, and bring forth, O daughter of Zion, As a travailing woman, For now, you go forth from the city, And you have dwelt in the field, And you have gone to Babylon, There you are delivered, There redeem you does Jehovah from the hand of your enemies.
4.11: And now, gathered against you have been many nations, who are saying: `Let her be defiled, and our eyes look on Zion.'
4.12: They have not known the thoughts of Jehovah, Nor have they understood His counsel, For He has gathered them as a sheaf into a threshing-floor.
4.13: Arise, and thresh, O daughter of Zion, For your horn I make iron, And your hoofs I make brass, And you have beaten small many peoples, And I have devoted to Jehovah their gain, And their wealth to the Lord of the whole earth!

5.1: Now gather yourself together, O daughter of troops, A siege he has laid against us, With a rod they smite on the cheek the judge of Israel.
5.2: And you, Beth-Lehem Ephratah, Little to be among the chiefs of Judah! From you to Me he comes forth--to be ruler in Israel, And his comings forth are of old, From the days of antiquity.
5.3: Therefore he does give them out till the time She who brings forth has brought forth, And the remnant of his brethren return to the sons of Israel.
5.4: And he has stood and delighted in the strength of Jehovah, In the excellency of the name of Jehovah his God, And they have remained, For now he is great to the ends of earth.
5.5: And this one has been peace, Asshur! when he does come into our land, And when he does tread in our palaces, We have raised against him seven shepherds, And eight anointed of man.
5.6: And they have afflicted the land of Asshur with the sword, And the land of Nimrod at its openings, And he has delivered from Asshur when he does come into our land, And when he treads in our borders.
5.7: And the remnant of Jacob has been in the midst of many peoples, As dew from Jehovah--as showers on the herb, That waits not for man, nor stays for the sons of men.
5.8: Yes, the remnant of Jacob has been among nations, In the midst of many peoples, As a lion among beasts of a forest, As a young lion among ranks of a flock, Which if it has passed through, Has both trodden down and has torn, And there is no deliverer.
5.9: High is your hand above your adversaries, And all your enemies are cut off.
5.10: And it has come to pass in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah, I have cut off your horses from your midst, And I have destroyed your chariots,
5.11: And I have cut off the cities of your land, And I have thrown down all your fortresses,
5.12: And have cut off sorcerers out of your hand, And observers of clouds you have none.
5.13: And I have cut off your graven images, And your standing-pillars out of your midst, And you do not bow yourself any more To the work of your hands.
5.14: And I have plucked up your shrines out of your midst, And I have destroyed your enemies.
5.15: And I have done vengeance in anger and in fury, With the nations who have not hearkened!

6.1: Hear, I pray you, that which Jehovah is saying: `Rise--strive you with the mountains, And cause you the hills to hear your voice.'
6.2: Hear, O mountains, the strife of Jehovah, You strong ones--foundations of earth! For a strife is to Jehovah, with His people, And with Israel He does reason.
6.3: O My people, what have I done to you? And what--have I wearied you? Testify against Me.
6.4: For I brought you up from the land of Egypt, And from the house of servants I have ransomed you, And I send before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
6.5: O My people, remember, I pray you, What counsel did Balak king of Moab, What answer him did Balaam son of Beor, (From Shittim to Gilgal,) In order to know the righteous acts of Jehovah.'
6.6: With what do I come before Jehovah? Do I bow to God Most High? Do I come before Him with burnt-offerings? With calves--sons of a year?
6.7: Is Jehovah pleased with thousands of rams? With myriads of streams of oil? Do I give my first-born for my transgression? The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
6.8: He has declared to you, O man, what is good; Yes, what is Jehovah requiring of you, Except--to do judgment, and love kindness, And lowly to walk with your God?
6.9: A voice of Jehovah to the city calls, And wisdom does fear Your name, Hear you the rod, and Him who appointed it.
6.10: Are there yet in the house of the wicked Treasures of wickedness, And the abhorred scanty ephah?
6.11: Do I reckon it pure with balances of wickedness? And with a bag of deceitful stones?
6.12: Whose rich ones have been full of violence, And its inhabitants have spoken falsehood, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
6.13: And I also, I have begun to smite you, To make desolate, because of your sins.
6.14: You--you eat, and you are not satisfied, And your pit is in your midst, And you remove, and do not deliver, And that which you deliver, to a sword I give.
6.15: You--you sow, and you do not reap, You--you tread the olive, And you pour not out oil, And new wine--and you drink not wine.
6.16: And kept habitually are the statutes of Omri, And all the work of the house of Ahab, And you do walk in their counsels, For My giving you for a desolation, And its inhabitants for a hissing, And the reproach of My people you do bear!

7.1: My woe is to me, for I have been As gatherings of summer-fruit, As gleanings of harvest, There is no cluster to eat, The first-ripe fruit desired has my soul.
7.2: Perished has the kind out of the land, And upright among men--there are none, All of them for blood lie in wait, Each his brother they hunt with a net.
7.3: On the evil are both hands to do it well, The prince is asking--also the judge--for recompence, And the great--he is speaking the mischief of his soul, And they wrap it up.
7.4: Their best one is as a brier, The upright one--than a thorn-hedge, The day of your watchmen--Your visitation--has come. Now is their perplexity.
7.5: Believe not in a friend, trust not in a leader, From her who is lying in your bosom keep the openings of your mouth.
7.6: For a son is dishonouring a father, A daughter has stood against her mother, A daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law, The enemies of each are the men of his house.
7.7: And I--in Jehovah I do watch, I do wait for the God of my salvation, Hear me does my God.
7.8: You do not rejoice over me, O my enemy, When I have fallen, I have risen, When I sit in darkness Jehovah is a light to me.
7.9: The indignation of Jehovah I do bear, For I have sinned against Him, Till that He does plead my cause, And has executed my judgment, He does bring me forth to the light, I look on His righteousness.
7.10: And see does my enemy, And cover her does shame, Who says to me, `Where is Jehovah your God?' My eyes do look on her, Now she is for a treading-place, As mire of the out-places.
7.11: The day to build your walls! That day--removed is the limit.
7.12: That day--even to you it does come in, From Asshur and the cities of the fortress, And from the fortress even to the river, And from sea to sea, and mount to mount.
7.13: And the land has been for a desolation, Because of its inhabitants, Because of the fruit of their doings.
7.14: Rule You Your people with Your rod, The flock of Your inheritance, Dwelling alone in a forest in the midst of Carmel, They enjoy Bashan and Gilead as in days of old.
7.15: According to the days of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt, I do show it wonderful things.
7.16: See do nations, and they are ashamed of all their might, They lay a hand on the mouth, their ears are deaf.
7.17: They lick dust as a serpent, as fearful things of earth, They tremble from their enclosures, Of Jehovah our God they are afraid, Yes, they are afraid of You.
7.18: Who is a God like You? taking away iniquity, And passing by the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance, He has not retained for ever His anger, Because He--He delights in kindness.
7.19: He does turn back, He pities us, He does subdue our iniquities, And You cast into the depths of the sea all their sins.
7.20: You give truth to Jacob, kindness to Abraham, That you have sworn to our fathers, from the days of antiquity!
